modes.name: Fill
modes.description: Study the table, watch it decay, then refill the blanks.
modes.note: Once every cell is gold the whole table blanks — gold must be defended.

modes.name: Snipe
modes.description: Your weakest cells from every table, one at a time.
modes.note: Roughly 70% from your current unit, 30% interleaved from earlier ones.

modes.name: Impostor
modes.description: One form in the table is fake. Find it.
modes.note: The fake is always a real neighbouring ending — never a random string.

modes.name: Lookup
modes.description: A form appears — tap the cell it belongs to.
modes.note: Ambiguous forms need every match: ἔλυον is both 1st singular and 3rd plural.

modes.name: Twin
modes.description: Two tables you keep confusing, drilled together.
modes.note: The pair is chosen from the confusions you have actually recorded.

modes.name: Race
modes.description: The whole table against a 60-second clock.
modes.note: Mistakes cost time, never mastery — the race never touches your record.

modes.name: Scramble
modes.description: Empty table, all forms loose in a bank. Drag each into place.
modes.note: Check is disabled until every slot is full; wrong cells are marked.
